lines: The old cottage beside PALLET HOUSE.
Grandma lived here when the restaurant was hers. Her roses still bloom by the door.

lines: The tool shed.
A rake, a spade and a broom lean against it. A cushion in the corner smells of... mime?

use.label: Look
lines: A scarecrow in a patched blue coat.
The PIDGEY sitting on its hat don't look scared at all.

use.label: Look
lines: The farm shed. Rakes, hoes and a spade hang on a rack by the door.
Someone has left the watering can full. The cabbages will be happy.

use.label: Read
lines: ROUTE 1 FARM
Cabbages and corn grow here. Please keep to the path.
Someone has added in pencil: RATTATA, stay out!

use.label: Look
lines: A little birdhouse on a pole.
A PIDGEY peeks out, decides you're not food, and goes back to sleep.

use.label: Look
lines: A rope swing on the old tree's low bough.
From up here the whole meadow sways like the sea.

use.label: Look
lines: You drop a coin in the telescope.
PALLET TOWN, tiny and bright in its green bowl... the harbour, the lighthouse... and the sea, all the way to the edge of the world.
Somewhere out there is CINNABAR ISLAND.

use.label: Read
lines: LOOKOUT
Below: PALLET TOWN, its harbour and the open sea.
On a clear day the wind carries the smell of salt all the way up here.

use.label: Read
lines: FLOWER MEADOW
Wildflowers in bloom! Please don't pick them.
In spring the ODDISH come out to dance here at night, they say.

use.label: Read
lines: BERRY ORCHARD
ORAN, PECHA, CHERI and RAWST BERRIES grow here.
Pick one a day, please! Leave some for the PIDGEY.

use.label: Look
lines: The little trees are heavy with BERRIES: blue ORAN, pink PECHA, red CHERI.
Wild POKéMON love them too. Something has nibbled the low ones.

use.label: Look
lines: An old stone bridge, soft with moss.
Down in the brook, a little POLIWAG swims against the current and gets nowhere.

use.label: Read
lines: TODAY'S TEA: green tea 50, barley tea 40, sweet dumplings 80, lemonade 60.
~ please rest a while ~

use.label: Look
lines: A little tea house with red benches and a big paper parasol.
The kettle sings on the coals. Someone has written TODAY'S TEA on a chalk board.

use.label: Look
lines: A tiny wayside shrine under a red gate.
Someone left a rice cake and a cup of tea. Travellers stop here to wish for a safe road.

use.label: Look
lines: A vending machine, humming to itself.
POKé COLA... FRESH WATER... SODA POP... LEMONADE. It only takes coins.

use.label: Read
lines: REST AREA
Tables, water and shade. Please take your rubbish home.
VIRIDIAN CITY: about an hour on foot.

npcs.name: POKé MART Clerk
lines: Hi there! I work at a POKé MART.
It's a convenient shop, so please visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.
I know, I'll give you a sample! Here you go!
ASH received a POTION!
We also carry POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON!

npcs.name: Tea keeper Hana
lines: Welcome, welcome! Sit down and rest your legs.
Travellers from PALLET TOWN always stop here before VIRIDIAN CITY.
The tea is green tea from my own bushes, and the water comes from the spring up the hill.
Oh, and if you see a PIDGEY on the parasol, don't shoo it. It's a regular.
